metadata.title: Real quadratic fields and finite quantum dilogarithms II: traces of quantum modular cocycles
metadata.abstract: We study traces of quantum modular cocycles at fixed points of hyperbolic elements $\gamma\in\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, formulate an algebraicity conjecture for these traces, and prove it for the cocycles associated to 1-dimensional state-integrals. In addition, we analyse a finite TQFT associated with $\gamma$ and conjecture that its invariants for 3-manifolds agree with the traces of their $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ quantum modular cocycles. The finite TQFTs predict a yet-to-be-defined motive with cohomology equipped with a $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$-degree grading and a $\mathbb{Z}$-weight grading coming from a version of the Riemann hypothesis, which suggests a similar grading should exist for an extension of the Kauffman bracket skein module, for the framed $\operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ Floer cohomology of Abouzaid--Manolescu, and for the quantum modular cocycle. This leads to surprising additive identities among algebraic units, which we confirm for the complement of the simplest hyperbolic knot $4_1$, as well as for $S^1 \times \Sigma_g$ for a closed genus $g$ surface.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 量子模cocycle迹的代数性与有限TQFT
analysis.workSummary: 研究SL₂(Z)双曲元素不动点处量子模cocycle的迹，提出代数性猜想并在一维state-integral对应cocycle中证明。另研究关联有限TQFT，猜想三流形不变量等于sl₂量子模cocycle迹；由此预测带奇偶与权分次的尚待定义motive及skein/Floer结构。
techniques: 代数单位的加法恒等式
analysis.breakthrough: 对figure-eight结补及S¹×Σg验证若干出人意料的代数单位恒等式。
analysis.limitations: 一般代数性、TQFT与迹对应及motive/分次推广仍是猜想或预测，不应叙述为已构造的理论；已证代数性限一维state-integral类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF第7页AI use disclosure明确称本论文准备和写作未使用LLM；其余候选及拆行/点写补检未见正面使用披露。该否定声明不构成AI使用证据，无披露也不扩大解释为所有可能工具环节均未使用AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 量子拓扑与数论联系较强，但本轮多数深层结论仍待证。
